description: Fill in public/lib.js exactly per its JSDoc (exact output strings). Write public/index.html, public/style.css and public/app.js: load Leaflet 1.9.4 from unpkg (pinned, with integrity), fetch /api/config, show OSM tiles with visible OpenStreetMap attribution, load cameras from /api/cameras on moveend when zoom >= minCameraZoom (circle markers, one placeholder color for Flock and one for other ALPRs, popup with manufacturer/operator), click cycle for start/end via nextClickState, buffer slider within config limits, Plan route button posting buildRouteRequest to /api/route, draw fastest (gray dashed) and avoiding (solid) routes, highlight hit cameras, results panel from summarizePlan, error messages from {error}, a note that coverage is incomplete, and 'Not affiliated with Flock Safety'. Title 'ALPR Route Planner'. No images or art. Unit tests for lib.js in test/unit/web.test.js; npm test must pass.
summary: Built the Leaflet map app in public/ (index.html, style.css, app.js, view.js) and filled lib.js per its JSDoc; 53 unit tests pass (lib, view helpers, and app.js against a fake Leaflet/DOM/fetch). Checked in a real browser against a fake API: tiles, cameras, popups, click cycle, both routes, highlights, results and phone layout work.
title: Build the browser map app in public/
